sequence_overrides_already_correct.reason: The course page lists 48850 under Year 3 December session. The session-heading pattern in parse_uts_sequences.py matched only Autumn, Spring and Summer, so the December heading did not register and the preceding Spring heading stayed in force. This put Civil and Environmental at 30cp in Year 3 Spring against 21cp in Year 4 Autumn, where every other major sits at 24 or 27. It also gave 48850 a wrong inferred availability, since 48850 is one of the nine subjects with no published availability and its session was inferred from this very placement.
